OG Bees Method®

Trusted by

Winning with UGC takes more than good creators. It takes a system.

The OG Bees Method is how we run every campaign: a repeatable process that turns your brief into vetted creators, scripted concepts, two layers of quality control and clear reporting, so every video earns its place.

Find out more

Connected capabilities

  • Creators
  • Content
  • Activation
  • Seeding
  • Reporting

UGC works best when everything is connected.

Creators, content, activations, seeding and reporting run as one system, managed by one team.

Together they help brands earn attention, build trust and drive real results.

Vetted creators across Egypt and MENA, matched to your niche, look and audience.

Ad-ready UGC videos you own, built from concepts and scripts we write with you.

Creators post on their own accounts, so your brand gets reach and real social proof.

Products and service trials in creators' hands, so every review comes from real use.

Clear results on every campaign, so you know what worked and what to scale.

Ethics

Clear with brands. Honest with audiences.

Read the full Ethics & Policy

Our promise to brands

  • Clear pricing before we start
  • No fake views or bought engagement
  • We never publish what a brand paid

To audiences

  • Paid posts are labelled as ads
  • Creators only show what they really tried
  • No misleading before & after

Data & privacy

  • Creator profiles are public only by opt-in
  • Brand data is shared only with permission
  • We keep only what the campaign needs

What 60+ campaigns taught us.

[Sample insights]
2s

Hook in 2 seconds

Videos that show the product in the first 2 seconds keep twice the viewers.

2x

Real homes beat studios

Lived-in rooms and real kitchens get twice the saves of a clean set.

+18

Speak the dialect

Egyptian Arabic voice-overs lift trust scores by up to 18 points.

5→1

Test 5, scale 1

Launch five hooks, keep the winner. One hook often brings most of the results.

How we measure impact.

Every case climbs the same ladder, from attention to money in the bank. We report all three levels, and we never publish what a brand paid.

  1. 01

    Attention

    Views, reach, thumb-stop rate and watch time.

  2. 02

    Engagement

    Saves, shares, comments and clicks.

  3. 03

    Business

    Sales, store visits, installs and cost per result, as % change.
